title: Enable screen help on Windows
goal: The per-user GUI helper runs at logon and reports ready

steps.title: Why a separate helper
steps.text: Windows services cannot see your desktop, so a small helper runs as you at logon. It never asks for uiAccess, so it cannot click into admin windows; those steps stay with you.

steps.title: Register the logon helper
steps.text: Run this in a normal (not admin) PowerShell.

steps.title: About capture
steps.text: While I capture the screen, an overlay names the apps I may control and offers Stop; Ctrl+Alt+End also stops me.
